description: Complete Streamlit UI - landing page, pipeline canvas, stage configurator, code viewer, executor panel, results dashboard, components library, and CSS styling. This creates the full interactive interface.
steps: Create neuropipeline/ui/styles.py - extend Agent 1 dark theme with new CSS variables (pipeline-node-bg: #141e30, pipeline-node-border: #1e3a5f, pipeline-node-active: #00d4ff22, pipeline-edge-color: #2563eb, pipeline-done: #22c55e, pipeline-running: #f59e0b, pipeline-pending: #334155, code-bg: #0d1117, code-border: #21262d, font-code: JetBrains Mono). Import Space Grotesk for headers. Include all Agent 1 base styles plus pipeline-specific node cards, code preview panels, status indicators

Create neuropipeline/ui/components.py - reusable UI components: pipeline_node_card(stage_name, status, stage_num), status_badge(status), code_block(code, language), metric_card(label, value, delta), stage_connection_arrow(), progress_indicator(current, total)

Create neuropipeline/ui/landing.py - Screen 1: JSON upload area (st.file_uploader for .json), option to upload raw dataset (triggers Agent 1 re-run), dataset summary card display after loading, task selection sidebar (Emotion Recognition, MDD Detection, Motor Imagery, Arrhythmia, Custom), model family selection sidebar, Build Pipeline button

Create neuropipeline/ui/pipeline_canvas.py - Screen 2: visual pipeline flow with connected stage nodes. Each node is a clickable card showing stage number, name, and status icon. Nodes connected with arrows (using st.columns layout). Handles EEG 8-stage and ECG 9-stage flows. Run All button. Click handler to select active stage

Create neuropipeline/ui/stage_configurator.py - dynamic config panel that renders different options based on selected stage and modality. Uses st.slider, st.number_input, st.radio, st.checkbox, st.multiselect for all the config options specified in the stage specs (quality threshold, filter settings, epoch params, feature types, model hyperparameters, evaluation strategy, etc.)

Create neuropipeline/ui/code_viewer.py - live code preview panel with syntax highlighting (st.code with language='python'). Updates in real-time as config changes. Copy button, Save button. Shows the rendered Jinja2 template output for the currently selected stage

Create neuropipeline/ui/executor_panel.py - execution panel using subprocess to run generated stage code. Shows live stdout streaming (st.empty() with periodic updates), execution time, success/failure status. Run single stage or Run All pipeline

Create neuropipeline/ui/results_dashboard.py - after model evaluation: display metrics (accuracy, F1, AUC), confusion matrix plot (plotly), ROC curve, per-subject accuracy bar chart, training/validation loss curves, classification report table. For ECG: add clinical metrics panel

Create neuropipeline/app.py - Streamlit entry point. Page config (wide layout, NeuroPipeline title, dark theme). Session state management for: current_screen (landing/canvas), pipeline_config, stage_states, generated_code dict, execution_results. Routes between screens. Sidebar with branding, task/model selection. Injects custom CSS from styles.py
acceptance_criteria: app.py can be imported without errors (python -c 'import neuropipeline.app')
All UI modules can be imported independently
styles.py get_custom_css() returns CSS string with all pipeline-specific variables
landing.py has render_landing() function that creates the upload interface
stage_configurator.py has render_stage_config(stage_name, modality, current_config) function
Session state initialization handles all required keys
